title: GenerationManifest/1.0
description: One record per /ticktock generation (cycle). It is the unit the lineage chain is made of: parent.parent_manifest_hash points at the previous generation's manifest_hash, so a reviewer walks the whole run mechanically instead of reconstructing it from narrative. A manifest carries what went in, what came out, what every locked reviewer said, what was measured, and which lane was rotated -- and it is written whether the cycle merged or halted, because a halted cycle is exactly the one whose record matters most.

generation_id.description: tt-gen-<cycle_index>-<charter_id>. Also the manifest's filename stem.

cycle_index.description: Zero-based generation index within this charter. Second term of every EFFECTFUL phase's idempotency key: TICK on cycle 3 and TICK on cycle 4 are never the same effect.

charter_hash.description: The charter this generation ran under. Constant across every generation of a run -- a change here means a new charter, therefore a new run, therefore a broken lineage unless the new charter records the old one as its predecessor.

parent.description: THE LINEAGE LINK. Both fields are null only for cycle_index 0; for any later cycle a null is a broken chain, not a fresh start.

benchmark_identical.description: Result of running the frozen colony at cycle start. False halts the cycle -- it is recorded here rather than merely acted on, so a reviewer can see that the benchmark ran at all.

journal_head_record_hash.description: record_hash of the journal's last record at cycle start. Ties the manifest to an exact point in the append-only journal.

artifact_hashes.description: Every input artifact the cycle read as authority, with its content hash at read time.

outputs.description: Every artifact the cycle produced, with the content hash confirmed by an independent re-read. May be empty when a cycle halts before producing anything.

reviews.description: One entry per LOCKED lane -- every lane in the charter roster appears here, including lanes that were unavailable or timed out. A missing lane is a defect, never an implicit pass.

model_pin_observed.description: What the lane actually resolved to. Null when the lane never returned. A value differing from model_pin_requested is a substitution.

pin_verified.description: True only when model_pin_observed was read from the response and equals model_pin_requested. Never inferred from the absence of an error.

status.description: Timeout, substituted, pin_mismatch, unavailable and error each independently mark the merge not-clean, regardless of the verdict field -- a zero-findings verdict from a lane that never properly ran is a validation failure, not a pass.

artifact_path.description: Where the lane's raw review output was written.

clean.description: True only when every locked lane returned status clean with zero unresolved findings AND the recomputed roster hash still matched the charter.

reasons.description: Why not clean, one entry per failing condition. Empty exactly when clean is true.

metrics.description: Measured quantities for this generation, keyed by evaluator name. Values are free-form because evaluators differ; the evaluator VERSIONS that produced them are pinned in the charter, which is what makes cross-generation comparison meaningful.

rotation.description: Rotation is mandatory per cycle: at least one previously untested mind/harness lane, recorded in the capabilities matrix. It is evidence-gathering, never permission to lower a gate -- there is no field here that can relax the merge contract.

halt.description: Present when the cycle halted. halt_state uses the journal's halt vocabulary so a manifest and a journal record never disagree about why a run stopped.

manifest_hash.description: sha256 of this document's canonical projection with manifest_hash removed. The next generation's parent.parent_manifest_hash must equal this value.
